item.title: [LU-20302] lbug with transparent huge pages
item.description:
we've seen about 50 client nodes crash over the past few months. we narrowed it down to one user code, and then distilled that into a simple reproducer. see attached.

seems like an interaction between transparent huge pages + direct io + mmap?

if the reproducer is run on 2 client nodes at the same time then almost always one of the 2 nodes will LBUG.

transparent huge pages on the client needs to be "madvise" or "always".
cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled
the node doesn't crash if thp is set to "never".

crashes are more reliably achieved if the client node is idle and VFS caches are dropped.
echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches

comments.comment:
FYI we had some more nodes crash today, so the bug still happens with THP turned off. although I guess it's harder to hit.

cheers,
robin

Have you tried the latest master?

There is some fix about THP read-ahead code.

Does the Lustre you tested include the following patch:

LU-18449 llite: handle kernel readahead for VM_HUGEPAGE vma

commit 4a9951dd7ea895930f5d5e264435e03f7b0f1930

https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/57038

 

I checked b2_15 (2.15.8) which did not include this fix.

I ran the reproducer on a pair of nodes with lustre master and they didn't LBUG.

can this please be backported into 2.15?

cheers,
robin

The patch depends on several patches:

 LU-17190 llite: release locks after all read-head pages submit

LU-18449 llite: handle kernel readahead for VM_HUGEPAGE vma

 

I pushed both patches to b2_15.

The topmost patch is: 

https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/66477 LU-18449 llite: handle kernel readahead for VM_HUGEPAGE vma
